# SetFont <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
SetFont:Void font:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `font` | In | Int32 | required | A handle from [LoadFont](LoadFont). 0 goes back to the built-in font. |

## Description

Chooses the font that [Text](Text), [Print](Print), [StringWidth](StringWidth) and the other text commands use from now on.

## Differences

* A font that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
